notes.title: PolyCrime v0.1.83 - v0.1.86 – Changelog_beta
notes.content:
[h2]PolyCrime v0.1.83 – Changelog_beta[/h2]

---

[h2]Gameplay / Systems[/h2]
[list]
[*] Police AI: adjusted patrol and chase logic for smoother reactions and fewer false engagements.
[*] Go-Kart Track: reworked colliders for more accurate contact and fairer collisions.
[*] New Shop Item: Baseball Bat now available in the store.
[/list]

[h2]UI / Audio[/h2]
[list]
[*] Hotbar Stack Count Color: uses the default color by day, switches to white at night for better readability.
[/list]

[h2]World / Visuals[/h2]
[list]
[*] City Lighting: added 250 functional street lamps across the city.
[*] City Design Tweaks: additional visual and layout polish to streets and public spaces.
[/list]


[h2]PolyCrime v0.1.85 – Changelog_beta[/h2]

---

[h2]Gameplay / Systems[/h2]
[list]
[*] Property Systems: introduced electricity, ventilation, water irrigation, and a dynamic “property suspicion” meter.
[*] Devices now have individual power draw; each property enforces a maximum capacity.
[*] Poor ventilation increases plant odor, raising suspicion and potentially attracting police attention.
[*] Overloading the grid triggers a total power outage for the property.
[*] Breaker Panel: every property now includes a dedicated electrical breaker panel with a status indicator.
[*] Can be switched OFF manually.
[*] Can be toggled back ON after an outage to restore power.
[/list]

[h2]World / Visuals[/h2]
[list]
[*] City Art Pass: additional visual polish and layout refinements across streets and public areas.
[/list]

[h2]Items[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Item: added a basic Fan (first step of the ventilation feature). More variants and property upgrade paths are planned.
[/list]




[h2]PolyCrime v0.1.86 — Changelog_beta[/h2]

---

[h2]Gameplay / Systems[/h2]
[list]
[*] Property Load Logic: properties now actively track and react to electric load, ventilation capacity, noise, and more. Expect smarter limits and clearer consequences.
[*] Power Outage FX: added a visual/audio FX burst when electricity cuts out, making outages more noticeable and readable.
[/list]

[h2]Property Upgrades[/h2]
[list]
[*] First Property Expansions: from the Property Tablet, you can now:
[*] Increase the kW limit (raise your maximum electrical capacity).
[*] Purchase improved ventilation to better control odor and reduce suspicion.
[/list]

[h2]UI[/h2]
[list]
[*] Money HUD Overhaul:
[*] Displays both Cash (on player) and Bank Balance.
[*] Added clear icons, refined positioning, and polished typography for readability.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Breaker Panel Placement Exploit: fixed an issue where players could place a lit stand while the breakers were tripped (no more powered placement during outages).
[*] Dev Script: cleaned up and fixed the internal dev script to prevent editor-time hiccups.
[*] 
[/list]

[h2]World / Visuals[/h2]
[list]
[*] New City Biome: introduced a Desert location to the open world—fresh vistas and new environmental flavor.
[/list]

notes.title: Casino Update: Multiplayer Blackjack Is Live (Beta)
notes.content:
[h2][/h2][p]The city just got a lot flashier. 💸[/p][p]We’ve opened a brand-new Casino—complete with a refreshed surrounding area—and rolled out Multiplayer Blackjack (Beta) powered by a dedicated casino games server.

[/p][h2]What’s inside[/h2][p]
Multiplayer Blackjack (Beta): You’ll be auto-matched to a free table to play with other players.

Casino district refresh: The casino area has been refined/relocated for a smoother flow and better vibe.

Robust tracking: We’ve expanded casino event logging to keep games stable and fair.

Seamless payments: Bets and payouts run directly through your bank account for now (a chip-exchange machine is planned).

[/p][h2]Good to know[/h2][p]
Singleplayer Blackjack is temporarily disabled while we focus on multiplayer testing.

You’ll find the Casino on the right side of the city—it’s hard to miss.

The world map hasn’t been updated yet; that’s coming in an upcoming patch.

[h2]Help us test![/h2]

This is a beta—we need your hands at the tables. Jump in, play a few rounds, and share your feedback and bug reports.
Interested in helping? Join our Discord [url="https://discord.gg/NynFRb5jdh"]https://discord.gg/NynFRb5jdh[/url][/p]

notes.title: POLYCRIME — We’re looking for Beta Testers!
notes.content:
[h1]POLYCRIME — We’re looking for Beta Testers![/h1]

[i]Hey heisters 👋
We’re opening a closed beta for PolyCrime, our stylish low-poly crime sandbox set in a living city full of gangs, cops, and risky deals. If you love testing, breaking things (in a helpful way!), and shaping a game before release, we want you on the case.[/i]

[b]What is PolyCrime?[/b]

[h3]PolyCrime is a fast-growing crime sim where you:[/h3]

Build your reputation and choose your path—street hustler, kingpin, or something in between.

Explore a hand-crafted low-poly city with day/night, patrols, and civilians going about their lives.

Face smart police AI (patrol, chase, arrest), dynamic encounters, and territory control by gangs.

Manage inventory & hotbar, trade (legal or… not so legal), and use an in-game dark web for risky plays.

Play solo or co-op with friends (Steam). Your choices ripple through the world.

[h2]What we’re testing[/h2]


Performance & stability across different PCs

Co-op sync (saving/loading, inventory, money, AI states)

Police and gang AI (patrols, detection, chases, arrests)

Economy balance (jobs, trading, risk vs. reward)

UX/UI (map, dialog, inventory, tooltips)

Global Online Marketplace — a cross-game trading hub shared by all players

New Darkweb Attack System — opt-in, PvP-style operations that can target your Steam friends

[h2]Coming up:[/h2]

Collectibles testing (new collectible items & progression hooks)

Casino update planned for next week (week of September 15, 2025) with new activities and balance passes
[h2]How to join[/h2]

Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/YQeXjAenEc


[h2]What you’ll get[/h2]

Early access to new builds & features

A special Discord role and a credit in the game (if you participate meaningfully)

Occasional exclusive play sessions with the devs

Our endless gratitude ❤️

[h2]What we expect[/h2]

Play new builds during test windows

Report issues with clear steps, screenshots, logs

Share honest feedback on difficulty, balance, and fun
